title: MarathonTS: a benchmark of long synthetic time series from window assembly and long-series generators
abstract: arXiv:2611.18190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool of short generated windows, which requires deciding which windows are taken, in what order, and how their seams are processed, or it can be produced directly by a long-series generator. This study presents MarathonTS, to our knowledge the first open benchmark that compares both families under one protocol. Every method produces a series of the same length on 9 open hourly datasets with 10 seeds. translated_title: MarathonTS：基于窗口组装与长序列生成器的长合成时间序列基准
translated_abstract: 许多合成时间序列的应用场景需要比生成模型训练所用的窗口长得多的序列。这样的序列既可以从短生成窗口池中组装而成（这需要决定选取哪些窗口、以何种顺序排列以及如何处理窗口间的接缝），也可以直接由长序列生成器生成。本研究提出了MarathonTS，据我们所知，这是首个在统一协议下比较这两类方法家族的开放基准。每种方法在9个开放的逐小时数据集上以10个随机种子生成相同长度的序列。序列的评估维度包括：对真实数据的保真度（12组共83个指标，对比三个真实参考集：训练集、验证集和按时间划分的集外数据）、实用性（模型仅在合成序列上训练并在真实数据上测试，即TSTR对比TRTR，涵盖14个分类和回归任务）、对训练数据的记忆程度以及计算成本。
tldr: MarathonTS是首个在统一协议下系统比较窗口组装与长序列生成器两类方法的长合成时间序列开放基准，从保真度、实用性、记忆性和计算效率多维度全面评估序列质量。
en_tdlr: MarathonTS is the first open benchmark to systematically compare window-assembly and long-series generator approaches under a unified protocol, evaluating long synthetic time series across fidelity, utility, memorisation, and computational cost.
